academic.workResult: Completed one governed Academic research object on MP-Bench. Deep Reading verified the benchmark construction, three-expert annotation design, disagreement distribution, consensus-ranked evaluation, sampling and cross-model results, and explicit limitations while preserving all results as source-reported rather than independently reproduced. Research Analysis derived a bounded four-layer diagnostic evidence envelope: immutable Trace Facts, plural Failure Hypotheses, Consensus/Salience kept distinct from evidence independence, and one governed Repair Decision. Produced an English/Chinese Academic Observation 005, one editorial cover and one inline conceptual figure. The article explicitly records that the paper and official repositories are primary/first-party evidence, the manuscript is under review, no independent full reproduction was found in this run, and the four-layer envelope is Research Center synthesis rather than a paper claim. Validate Research Center 3.0 run 32946841264 passed on the final bilingual article commit before terminal completion was requested.
academic.workResult_zh: 围绕 MP-Bench 完成 1 个受治理 Academic 研究对象。Deep Reading 核验了基准构造、三名专家独立标注、分歧分布、基于共识的排序评估、采样与跨模型实验以及论文明确限制，并把全部实验数字严格保留为来源方报告，而非独立复现。Research Analysis 在证据边界内形成四层诊断证据包络：不可变 Trace Facts、可并存 Failure Hypotheses、与证据独立性分开记录的 Consensus/Salience，以及一个受治理 Repair Decision。完成中英文 Academic Observation 005、1 张编辑封面和 1 张正文概念图。文章明确记录：论文与官方仓库属于一手/第一方证据，稿件仍处于 under review，本次未找到完整独立复现，四层包络属于 Research Center 综合判断而非论文作者主张。终态完成请求前，最终双语文章提交已通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 run 32946841264。
